ValidationRule.description: Expenses cannot be added or changed once the claim is submitted, unless it was rejected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISPICKVAL( Trip__r.Claim_Status__c, "Not Submitted" ) ), NOT( ISPICKVAL( Trip__r.Claim_Status__c, "Rejected" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This claim is already submitted. Expenses are locked.
